title: Kuzevezera Mumhepo
intro: Fungidzira nzvimbo iyo zvisingaonekwi nezvinoonekwa zvakabatana, uye iwe unomira pamberi pemunhu ari pakati peumambo hwakasiyana nehumwe. Mweya uyu une ruzivo rwusingawanikwe nevanhu, masimba anotonga ayo vamwe vangangofungidzira. Asi, kunyange ane simba guru anogona kuderedzwa nechisikwa chidiki, uye chokwadi chingaramba chakavanzika kusvika panguva yakatarwa. Ndiani munhu uyu ane nhaka inodzokororwa mumakore ese?
clues: Ndakapiwa umambo husina mumwe munhu aizonditevera.
Ndakagara nhaka ruzivo neuchenjeri kubva kumubereki wandinoda.
Mhepo yaive pasi pemurairo wangu, ichifamba nemurairo wangu chero kwandaida.
Ndaigona kunzwisisa kutaura kweshiri, uye dzaishanda muuto rangu.
Ndakagamuchira nhau kubva kune imwe shiri diki nezvemambokadzi ainamata zuva.
Rufu rwangu rwakaramba rwakavanzwa kusvika chisikwa chepasi chadya tsvimbo yangu, uye ipapo ndipo majini paakaziva kuti aisaziva zvisingaonekwe.

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Rufu rwake rwakavanzwa kubva kumajini kusvika tsvimbo yake yadyiwa
outcome.answer: Rufu rwake rwakavanzwa kubva kumajini kusvika tsvimbo yake yadyiwa

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
